title: PIMS-10109-iCoast Jamaica PPG
description: This initiation Plan aims to influence behavioral changes through the introduction of sustainable tourism approaches, practices, technologies and business models through the development of a coherent policy and regulatory environment, increase the availability of financial incentives and financing that can support a transition to sustainable practices, demonstrate sustainable business models and practices as well as create awareness and ensure knowledge dissemination.

title: Preparation of National Inventory of Banks of Waste-Controlled Substances
description: This project aims to assist in the preparation of national inventory banks (NIBs) of used or unwanted controlled substances, including consideration of recycling, reclamation and cost-effective destruction within the framework described in paragraphs 16 to 32 document UNEP/OzL.Pro/ExCom/91/66.

title: JARRI-Jamaica Resilient Recovery Intiative-01005173
description: Hurricane Melissa, a Category 5 storm, struck Jamaica on October 28, 2025, resulting in unprecedented devastation to communities, infrastructure, and essential services. As the strongest hurricane to hit the island in 174 years, it caused extensive destruction, loss of lives, and livelihoods, with initial damage estimated at 41% of the 2024 GDP.Following the disaster, the Government of Jamaica (GOJ) declared the entire country a disaster area and prioritized rapid debris clearance, livelihood restoration, and energy solutions to facilitate early recovery and reconstruction. In support of these efforts, UNDPs Jamaica Resilient Recovery Initiative (JARRI) will provide technical and financial assistance to stabilize communities, restore livelihoods, and help national authorities and key sectors Build Forward Better by integrating resilience measures throughout the recovery process.At the national level, JARRI will contribute to recovery planning and post-hurricane impact assessments, emphasizing root cause analysis, human impacts, and the application of spatial planning, geospatial, and digital tools. The initiative will also focus on community stabilization through key interventions such as debris clearance and management, livelihood and SME recovery, re-roofing, and solar energy solutions to meet essential needs and support long-term resilience
